utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twentieth of April. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: We can hear you. Anyone see the football last night? Honestly, that last ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, unfortunately. I'd nearly recovered until you mentioned it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I avoided it. Our weekend plans were a walk and a pub lunch, but the weather put paid to the walk.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: So just the pub lunch, then. Terrible outcome.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Next weekend we're planning the garden, weather permitting. Which probably means another pub lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the leisure committee. Anything finished that we can get off the board?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, finished the repair on the line 3 chiller last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Closed, not another job for this shift.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I tested the Gas Turbine 1 yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's the one I saw marked complete, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, same one. Finished, no outstanding bit hidden underneath it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the line 1 mould temp yesterday as well. That's complete.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, cheers. Anything from nights that's just information?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Noticed the wrapper was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down. Just an observation, not raising a job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, understood. Not something still sitting there hot.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing: saw the pressure on the Compressed Air Dryer dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. Just passing that on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, heard. A dip that recovered, not a new fault-finding job from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the line three. Nothing we can do until they arrive, so that remains blocked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's parked. Separate from the chiller repair I've finished.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the outfeed conveyor is cancelled now. Production need it running, so that shutdown isn't happening.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, cancelled, not postponed onto somebody's list today. Let's get the actual commitments straight.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the IM2 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. The IM2 risk assessment, this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've also got the seals on the MV01 needing replacement. Who's taking that one?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the MV01 next week. Drop everything for that one, yeah — that's the priority I'll give it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you. Next week still, rather than bringing it forward?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Next week, definitely. High urgency when we do it, not changing it to today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Jamie Brennan has the MV01 seals next week. Drop everything for that one. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, if you've got a spare minute, can you send the shift handover report round?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. It's a spare-minute one, no need to bump anything else for it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll go to Tollgate Water Treatment Works to pick up the replacement parts for the cooling tower tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Tomorrow for the collection, yeah? Sorry, your sound clipped at the end.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow. And drop everything for that one — I'll treat that collection as the priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Tollgate Water Treatment Works, replacement parts for the cooling tower, tomorrow. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I'll do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, that's on the 3rd, with the contractor at the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's right, on the 3rd. I'll do that visit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tomasz Nowak, can you chase the purchase order for the Compressed Air Dryer by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes, I'll chase the purchase order for the Compressed Air Dryer by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just to keep those separate, that's the purchase order chase. My pressure comment earlier was only something I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. The purchase order is the action, the pressure dip was information.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll take vibration readings on the number two bearing on Friday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Olu, number two bearing readings on Friday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. I'll take those, no rush-job label on that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Normal priority. Nice to hear those words together for once.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't get too comfortable. Grace Liu, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. I've got the IM2 risk assessment this morning, and I haven't got the capacity to organise the talk as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Jamie, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team instead?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team. That's with me instead.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks. Definitely handed over, then, rather than both of us thinking the other one's got it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, mine. Teams has witnesses and everything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And the two drop-everything jobs keep the dates we've said. Urgent doesn't mean we've quietly moved them into this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Makes sense. Otherwise everything ends up in the same red box and the box stops meaning anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Line three stays blocked on parts, and the outfeed conveyor shutdown is cancelled. Neither is a new action.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All clear from me. At least this plan's firmer than my weekend weather forecast.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And less depressing than the football, hopefully.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Low bar. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
